competences.description: Reaps the life of the enemy with a deadly scythe. Acquires an additional turn if the enemy dies.
Attacks all enemies with a deadly scythe and inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns. The Critical Rate increases to 100% if the enemy's HP is 30% or lower.

Increases the amount of damage all allies and enemies receive from Continuous Damage by two times. Disturbs the HP recovery for 2 turns with a 50% chance and inflicts Continuous Damage if you attack an enemy on your turn. If you attack an enemy who already has Continuous Damage, your attacks won't land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]
